title: SEO
subtitle: Technical and content SEO that compounds organic growth.
description: Digital Curd designs and delivers SEO as part of a connected growth system—so marketing, technology, and AI work together instead of in silos. We focus on measurable outcomes: more qualified demand, smoother operations, and digital experiences that convert.

outcomes.title: Clear growth outcomes
outcomes.description: We align SEO work to pipeline, revenue, efficiency, or experience KPIs from day one.

outcomes.title: Connected delivery
outcomes.description: Strategy, build, and optimization stay linked so insights from one channel improve the rest.

outcomes.title: AI-ready foundation
outcomes.description: We structure data, content, and workflows so automation and AI can compound results over time.

capabilities.title: Discovery & strategy
capabilities.description: Audit current state, competitors, and opportunities to define a practical roadmap.

capabilities.title: Build & integration
capabilities.description: Implement the stack, journeys, and experiences needed to make SEO perform.

capabilities.title: Measurement & learning
capabilities.description: Instrument analytics and feedback loops so every sprint improves conversion and ROI.

capabilities.title: Ongoing optimization
capabilities.description: Iterate creatives, flows, and technical performance with a continuous improvement cadence.

process.title: Align
process.description: Clarify goals, audience, constraints, and success metrics for SEO.

process.title: Design
process.description: Map the experience, architecture, and growth system required to deliver.

process.title: Launch
process.description: Ship production-ready work with QA, tracking, and stakeholder enablement.

process.title: Scale
process.description: Optimize against live data and expand what is already working.

faqs.question: How long does a typical SEO engagement take?
faqs.answer: Most discovery-to-launch cycles run 4–12 weeks depending on scope. Ongoing optimization retainers then refine performance month over month.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate with your marketing, product, and engineering workflows and prefer to extend your current stack when it is fit for purpose.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: We define KPIs during kickoff—such as qualified leads, ROAS, conversion rate, ticket deflection, or page performance—and report against them clearly.
